name: GEE Ltd
title: GEE Ltd - 504028 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: GEE's utilisation rose from 48% to about 57% with management guiding to 25–30% revenue CAGR and 10%+ EBITDA margin, but capacity additions are small and the story rests on unverified targets and a land monetisation.

utilisation.quote: this utilization has come down, did come down last year to 48%, which has gone up to around 57%

capex.quote: there are going to be a few ancillary machines. And apart from that, we are also shifting our facility

triggers.label: Utilisation 48% → 57%
triggers.quote: the utilization has come down, did come down last year to 48%, which has gone up to around 57%

triggers.label: Revenue CAGR 25–30% to FY29
triggers.quote: We are looking at a 25% to 30% target revenue growth CAGR till FY29

triggers.label: Flux-cored wire production from July
triggers.quote: soon in July, we will commence our own production

guidance.value: 25-30% till FY29; INR 1,000 crore by FY29-30
guidance.quote: We are looking at a 25% to 30% target revenue growth CAGR till FY29
We are looking at a double digit plus actually. We are looking at a 10% plus margin EBITDA margin
INR45 crores of EBITDA, of course, is something that we are looking at for this year as well

guidance.value: more than INR50 cr per annum
guidance.quote: we are planning to get around more than INR50 cr. revenue from flux core wires every annum

red_flags.label: Thin PAT margin, targets far above FY26 run-rate
red_flags.quote: the PAT stands at around INR13 crores, which is a 3.5% PAT margin

red_flags.label: Land monetisation proceeds vs shareholder reward unclear
red_flags.quote: the shareholders will definitely be suitably rewarded

red_flags.label: Management claims lower prices than peers in retail

evasions.quote: I think that figure, we can get back to you.
I don't know, but we are investing, I think, not as much, but then we are investing into R&D, into equipments.
it's very difficult to give a breakup of that.

evasions.quote: I won't be able to compare it
